Q: Martha makes special pinwheel hats in her home in Salem, Oregon. She only markets her hats on the west coast (California, Oregon, and Washington). Alex, a citizen of Maine, purchases one of the hats while visiting Salem. When Alex returns to Maine, the pinwheel comes off and seriously cuts Alex. Alex sues Martha for damages in California. A:
